name: Plain Money Calculators
description: Free, no-sign-up calculators for US personal finance (mortgages, loans, credit card payoff, take-home pay, 401(k), savings), plus health and everyday math, with plain-English guides that work through real numbers. Calculations run in the browser; each page states its formula, assumptions and sources.
data_handling: Calculations run in the browser; entered numbers are not sent to the server.
disclaimer: Estimates only, not financial, tax, legal or medical advice.
